Converts Zelda: Skyward Sword HD saves from v1.0.1 to v1.0.0, so they load in Sky Recomp and other v1.0.0 setups instead of showing "The file cannot be used because the data is corrupted." Your original save is never modified.

**Which file?** Windows: `sshd-save-downgrader-windows.exe`. macOS (Apple Silicon): `sshd-save-downgrader-macos.zip`. Linux: `sshd-save-downgrader-linux`. Anything with Python 3.8+: the `.py` files. The apps are unsigned, so see the [README](https://github.com/robert-neagu/sshd-save-downgrade#download) for the one-time first-launch step.
